lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly) and assigned to sub-national geographic units in Kenya. The data covers current and projected scenarios (medium-term projections) for February, June, and October 2016, stored as vector geographic files (GeoJSON/KML) with IPC phase values and scenario metadata.
